title: Media Buy Issue
description: Seller-owned report status, separate from transport task status and MediaBuy revision. Only the seller may acknowledge or resolve it. Reporting never changes delivery or commercial terms.

status.description: reported is an automated receipt only. acknowledged means a person has taken responsibility. resolved means that person or their team recorded a terminal resolution. A seller may resolve immediately only if it also records human acknowledgement.

acknowledged_at.description: Time of human acknowledgement, never an automated receipt.

resolution.description: Buyer-safe resolution summary. Resolution may explain why no seller action was warranted; it does not prove the buyer agreed or waive a dispute.

verifier_constraints.issue_scope: All identifiers belong to the requested account and media buy. The caller is authorized for that media buy. If both package_id and creative_id are supplied, the creative was associated with that package at the reported incident; removed associations remain reportable.
verifier_constraints.lifecycle: received_at <= acknowledged_at <= resolved_at when present; transitions are reported -> acknowledged -> resolved or reported -> resolved with human acknowledgement. Identity, report content, and received_at are immutable. Status never regresses.
verifier_constraints.response_commitment: A critical report uses the elapsed human-response commitment resolved when received. Later action or policy changes cannot weaken that commitment. An automated receipt is not human acknowledgement.
